title: Watch Your Grammar Change When the Storm Hits
attack_summary: Non-count pattern (iltifat / grammatical person-shift). Primary attack: REAL vs IMPOSED. The single-verse spine passes every gate -- substrate 100% verified from corpus features and the exact turn is classically NAMED verbatim by al-Jalalayn. Not a disguised count, Quran-only, and the pronoun lens is genuinely absent from the existing tadabbur. Does NOT get refuted. But the secondary cross-passage layer overclaims a grammatical pattern the corpus disproves, and the devotional payoff is already published -- both correctable without touching the spine.

substrate_verification.10:22: yusayyiru-KUM (V 3MS + obj 2MP), kun-TUM (PERF 2MP) = God addressing YOU; jarayna (V 3FP, the ships) bi-HIM (3MP), farihu (3MP), ja'at-ha (3FS), ja'a-HUMU (3MP), zannu (3MP), anna-HUM (3MP), uhita bi-HIM (PASS 3MS + 3MP), da'aw (3MP), mukhlisin (3MP) = passengers referred to as THEM; anjay-TA (PERF 2MS) -na (1P) = sailors' quoted vow addressing GOD as YOU. Every person-value asserted in both exhibits confirmed.
substrate_verification.cross_passages: 6:63 yunajji-KUM 2MP, tad'una-HU 2MP; quoted vow 'la'in anja-NA' = anja (3MS, HE) + na (1P) -> vow refers to God in THIRD person ('if He delivers us'), NOT 2nd-person. 17:67 massa-KUM / tad'una / najja-KUM / a'radtum ALL 2MP, closing 'kana al-insanu kafuran' 3MS -> stays in khitab throughout, NO you->them drift, NO quoted vow. 31:32 ghashiya-HUM / da'aw / najja-HUM / fa-min-HUM ALL 3rd person -> NO 2nd person anywhere.

imposed_test.device: PASS / RECOVERED. al-Jalalayn on 10:22 states verbatim, pulled live via cross_reference_tafsir: (wa-jarayna bihim) fihi iltifatun 'an al-khitab. The classical tradition named THIS EXACT WORD as the turn. Device is real, not projected.
imposed_test.meaning: SOFT SPOT. al-Jalalayn names only the DEVICE. The specific psychological MEANING the thesis assigns ('comfort turns God into third person', 'you become a spectacle watched from outside', 'crisis restores intimacy') is a modern devotional gloss on the named device, NOT stated by the mufassir. Must be framed as reflection layered on a classically-named device, not attributed to al-Jalalayn. The candidate's imposed_check defends person-values + device-naming (both valid) but does NOT defend the meaning-mapping as classical.

disguised_count_test: PASS. Grammatical person-shift; not reducible to any word-frequency claim.
quran_only_test: PASS. Corpus grammar + tafsir only; no hadith payoff.

overlap_audit.tadabbur_010-yunus_021-024: EXISTS and covers 10:22 in full. Section 3 'Storms Strip the Soul Down to Tawhid', Theme 1 'Crisis Sincerity Is Not the Same as Lasting Servanthood', and the reflection prompt 'what vows have I made to Allah in storms that became faint once the sea grew calm?' ALREADY deliver the thesis's devotional payoff. grep for iltifat/pronoun/person/grammar/shift -> ZERO hits: the pronoun-choreography lens is genuinely absent. Net: the MORAL is already published; only the GRAMMAR-AS-EVIDENCE lens is new.
overlap_audit.published_articles: 'The Drowning That Came Too Late' is Yunus 10:90-92 (Fir'awn's too-late belief) + Fir'awn's 'ana' in An-Nazi'at -- DIFFERENT verse, opposite case, no 10:22 iltifat. Site already runs a grammar/pronoun-reveal genre ('Grammar of Tyranny', 'Isa's grammar of permission', 'Two Processions'), so 'flagship of a NEW franchise' is marketing, not novelty. No article touches 10:22's iltifat. No fatal overlap.

broken_claims: Exhibit ILTIFAT-1 reveal: 'The choreography repeats across the sea-rescues (6:63-64, 17:67, 31:32): faith that only says You in the storm and forgets Him into He/them on dry land.' GRAMMATICALLY FALSE as a repeating pattern: 17:67 stays 2nd-person (khitab) throughout with NO drift to 'them'; 31:32 is entirely 3rd-person with NO 2nd-person 'You' anywhere; 6:63's quoted vow is 'if HE saves us' (anja 3MS), not 'if YOU save us.' The you->them->You(-to-God) pronoun choreography is UNIQUE to 10:22. What repeats is the THEME (crisis-sincerity then post-rescue forgetting); the grammar DIVERGES sharply verse to verse.

Thesis/exhibit framing that terror 'snaps the grammar back' / 'restores the second' person: the closing 2nd person (anjay-TA 2MS) is the drowning sailors addressing GOD -- a DIFFERENT second-person vector than the opening (God addressing the human audience). It is a mirror/inversion, not a restoration of the original address; two opposite speakers. Must be stated explicitly or a critic lands 'you conflated two speakers.'

Thesis header 'al-Zamakhshari's textbook case' and exhibit 'al-Razi discusses it': NOT verifiable with the available tool (cross_reference_tafsir returns only al-Jalalayn, al-Tabari, al-Muyassar, Ibn Kathir). 10:22 IS a genuine locus classicus for iltifat, but these specific secondary attributions were not checked here; the verified al-Jalalayn quote alone sustains 'classically named.'
required_corrections: 1) CROSS-PASSAGE: drop or rewrite 'the choreography repeats across 6:63/17:67/31:32.' The corpus shows the grammar does NOT repeat -- 17:67 is all-khitab, 31:32 is all-ghayba, 6:63's vow says 'if HE saves us.' Reframe as a THEMATIC family (crisis-faith + post-rescue forgetting), restrict the pronoun-choreography claim to 10:22 alone (or make the grammatical DIVERGENCE the point), and keep the section flagged as modern synthesis. 2) DIRECTIONAL FLIP: state that the closing 'You' is the sailors' voice addressing God (an inversion), not the narrator resuming address to them -- the candidate's own ground_notes already require this; make it explicit in body copy. 3) DEVICE vs MEANING: attribute only 'fihi iltifat 'an al-khitab' to al-Jalalayn; present 'comfort=distance / crisis=intimacy / spectacle' as reflective reading, not classical. 4) SECONDARY CITES: verify Zamakhshari/Razi against primary text before printing, or lean on the verified al-Jalalayn anchor (optionally al-Suyuti's al-Itqan if verifiable). 5) REDUNDANCY: the existing 010-yunus/ayahs-021-024 tadabbur already delivers the devotional payoff; foreground the pronoun mechanism as the article's reason to exist and link the tadabbur, don't re-deliver the moral as if new.
load_bearing_status: The load-bearing spine (single-verse 10:22 iltifat, classically named + mechanically verified) is INTACT. All broken claims live in the secondary cross-passage layer (already flagged modern) or in framing/attribution discipline -- none topples the spine. Hence SURVIVES, not REFUTED.
hostile_one_tweet_rebuttals: 'iltifat khitab->ghayba is a stock Quranic device with many purposes; al-Jalalayn named the DEVICE, not your comfort=distance moral -- that's a modern reading in classical clothes.' -> Blunted by device/meaning discipline (correction 3); the device-naming IS verified verbatim.

'Your you->them->You arc conflates two opposite speakers -- the closing You is the drowning man to God, not God to you.' -> Blunted by correction 2; the arc is a mirror, arguably a STRONGER payoff once stated honestly.

'You said the choreography repeats across the sea verses -- but 17:67 never leaves you, and 31:32 never says you. Check your own grammar.' -> This one LANDS on the reveal as written; correction 1 is mandatory.
